package.description: A free comic book archive format (*.cbr) file reader.

en-US.description: A free comic book archive format (*.cbr) file reader.
en-US.longDescription: CBR Reader is a free *.cbr file reader, the CBR is a very popular comic book archive format, this program can help you to easily open and view these comic book files, it also supports other similar comic format files, such as *.cbz, *.cb7, *.cbt and *.cba files. So, if you are a comic fan, this is a very useful software. At the best, it is completely free.
en-US.name: CBR Reader
